CENTRAL GOVERNMENT SCHEMES

Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)

  • Launched in: 2000
  • Ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
  • Purpose: Provide all-weather road connectivity to rural villages.

Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA)

  • Launched in: 2001
  • Ministry: Ministry of Education
  • Purpose: Free compulsory elementary education for children between 6-14 years (Class I-VIII).

Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)

  • Launched in: 2005
  • Became effective in: 2006
  • Ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
  • Purpose: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households to enhance livelihood security.
  • Renamed from NREGA to MGNREGA on 2nd Oct, 2009.

National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) – Now part of Ayushman Bharat

  • Launched in: 2005
  • Ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
  • Purpose: Improve healthcare infrastructure in rural areas, reduce infant mortality, and provide accessible medical services.

National Food Security Act (NFSA)

  • Launched in: 2013
  • Ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
  • Purpose: Provide subsidised food grains (rice, wheat, coarse cereals) to ~67% of India's population under the Public Distribution System (PDS).

Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)

  • Launched in: 2014
  • Ministry: Ministry of Finance
  • Purpose: Financial inclusion by providing zero-balance bank accounts, insurance, and overdraft facilities to the unbanked poor.

Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM)

  • Launched in: 2014
  • Ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti (Rural) / Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (Urban)
  • Purpose: Eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management. Urban: SBM-U, Rural: SBM-G.

Make in India

  • Launched in: 2014
  • Ministry: Ministry of Commerce & Industry
  • Purpose: Boost manufacturing, attract FDI, and create jobs by promoting India as a global manufacturing hub.

Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)

  • Launched in: 2015
  • Ministry: PMAY-Gramin (Rural): Ministry of Rural Development; PMAY-Urban: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
  • Purpose: Affordable housing for the urban and rural poor.

Digital India

  • Launched in: 2015
  • Ministry: Ministry of Electronics & IT
  • Purpose: Transform India into a digitally empowered society (e-governance, broadband connectivity, digital literacy).

Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)

  • Launched in: 2015
  • Ministry: Ministry of Finance
  • Purpose: Provide loans (up to ₹20 lakh) to micro/small businesses and entrepreneurs.

Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)

  • Launched in: 2015
  • Ministry: Ministry of Women & Child Development
  • Purpose: Improve girl child education, reduce gender discrimination, and curb female foeticide.

Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)

  • Launched in: 2016
  • Ministry: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas
  • Purpose: Provide free LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.

Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)

  • Launched in: 2016
  • Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
  • Purpose: Crop insurance for farmers against natural disasters at subsidized premiums.

Startup India

  • Launched in: 2016
  • Ministry: Ministry of Commerce & Industry
  • Purpose: Promote startups through tax benefits, funding, and simplified regulations.

Stand-Up India

  • Launched in: 2016
  • Ministry: Ministry of Finance
  • Purpose: Promote entrepreneurship among SC/ST and women by providing bank loans (₹10 lakh – ₹1 crore).

Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

  • Launched in: 2018
  • Ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
  • Purpose: World's largest health insurance scheme (₹5 lakh/year per family) for economically vulnerable households.

Aspirational Districts Programme

  • Launched in: 2018
  • Authority: NITI Aayog
  • Purpose: Focused on 112 backward districts.

Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)

  • Launched in: 2019
  • Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
  • Purpose: Direct income support of ₹6,000/year to small and marginal farmers.

One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC)

  • Launched in: 2019 (nationwide by 2021)
  • Ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs
  • Purpose: Enable portability of food security benefits across India for migrant workers.

Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM)

  • Launched in: 2019
  • Ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
  • Purpose: Provide piped potable water to every rural household by 2024.

PM SVANidhi

  • Launched in: 2020
  • Ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
  • Purpose: Provide micro-credit (up to ₹10,000) to street vendors affected by COVID-19.

Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

  • Launched in: 2020 (COVID-19 relief)
  • Ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs
  • Purpose: Free food grains (5 kg/person/month) to 80 crore beneficiaries during the pandemic.

National Education Policy (NEP) 2020

  • Launched in: 2020
  • Ministry: Ministry of Education
  • Purpose: Overhaul India's education system with focus on skill development, multilingualism, and digital learning.

National Digital Health Mission (NDHM) – Now Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission

  • Launched in: 2020
  • Ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
  • Purpose: Create digital health IDs and a unified health infrastructure for seamless medical services.

PM Gati Shakti - National Master Plan

  • Launched in: 2021
  • Ministry: Ministry of Commerce & Industry
  • Purpose: Infrastructure development with multi-modal connectivity (roads, rails, ports) to boost logistics efficiency.

PM Schools for Rising India (PM-SHRI)

  • Launched in: 2022
  • Ministry: Ministry of Education
  • Purpose: Modernize 14,500 schools with digital labs, vocational training, and holistic education.

Kisan Rin Portal

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
  • Purpose: Digital platform for farmers to access subsidized loans under Kisan Credit Card (KCC).

Anand Matrimony Scheme

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
  • Purpose: Financial assistance (₹2.5 lakh/couple) for inter-caste marriages to promote social harmony.

PM Vishwakarma Yojana

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
  • Purpose: Support traditional artisans (carpenters, blacksmiths, etc.) with skill training, loans, and market linkages.

National Green Hydrogen Mission

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy
  • Purpose: Make India a global hub for green hydrogen production (₹19,744 crore investment).

Dekho Apna Desh

  • Launched in: 2022
  • Ministry: Ministry of Tourism
  • Purpose: Promote domestic tourism with discounts on flights, trains, and curated travel package.

SHRESHTA Schools

  • Launched in: 2022
  • Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
  • Purpose: Provide quality education to SC students through CBSE-affiliated residential schools.

Vibrant Villages Programme

  • Launched in: 2022
  • Ministry: Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Purpose: Develop infrastructure in border villages (especially China-facing areas) to curb migration. 4 states (Arunachal Pr., Sikkim, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pr.) + 1 UT (Ladakh).

PM-YUVA 2.0

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Education
  • Purpose: Mentor young authors and promote Indian literature globally.

Namo Bharat (RRTS)

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
  • Purpose: India's first regional rapid transit system (Delhi-Meerut corridor, 180 km/h trains).

PM-SURAJ Portal

  • Launched in: 2024
  • Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
  • Purpose: Centralized platform for SC/ST entrepreneurs to access credit and entrepreneurship schemes.

Agnipath Scheme

  • Launched in: 2022
  • Ministry: Ministry of Defence
  • Purpose: Transform military recruitment with 4-year contractual service (45,000 'Agniveers' annually).

e-SHRAM Portal

  • Launched in: 2021
  • Ministry: Ministry of Labour & Employment
  • Purpose: National database of 38+ crore unorganized workers for targeted welfare delivery.

PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM-JANMAN)

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
  • Purpose: Provide basic facilities (housing, roads, telecom) to 75 Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs).

PRITHVI Vigyan (Earth Science Scheme)

  • Launched in: 2021
  • Ministry: Ministry of Earth Sciences
  • Purpose: Enhance research in earth sciences (climate, oceanography, seismology) for disaster management and sustainable development.

PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)

  • Launched in: 2020
  • Ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
  • Purpose: Boost fish production to 22 million tons by 2025; supports 55 lakh fishermen/fish farmers.

Vivad se Vishwas (VSV)

  • Launched in: 2020
  • Ministry: Ministry of Finance
  • Purpose: Settle tax disputes by waiving 100% penalty for pending cases if paid by March 2021.

Atal Pension Yojana (APY)

  • Launched in: 2015
  • Ministry: Ministry of Finance
  • Purpose: Pension scheme for workers in the unorganized sector (guaranteed post-retirement income).

ADITI Scheme (Acting Development of Innovative Technologies with Innovation)

  • Launched in: 2024
  • Ministry: Ministry of Defence
  • Purpose: Fund startups and MSMEs developing military-grade tech (drones, AI, cybersecurity). Targets 300+ startups with grants up to ₹25 crore.

UNNATI Scheme (Uttam Nagrik Nidhi Awas Takniki Initiative)

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
  • Purpose: Upskill urban poor in construction (6-month training). Aims to train 50,000 annually under PM SVANidhi linkage.

PRERNA Programme (Pradhan Mantri Encouragement for Rationalizing Norms in Agriculture)

  • Launched in: 2022
  • Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
  • Purpose: Reduce chemical fertilizer use through farmer training. Focus on 10 lakh farmers in 100 districts.

Namo Drone Didi

  • Launched in: 2024
  • Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
  • Purpose: Train 15,000 women SHG members as drone pilots for crop monitoring/spraying.

PM USHA (Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan)

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Education
  • Purpose: Upgrade 1,500+ state universities/colleges. Prioritizes NE, aspirational districts.

Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana

  • Launched in: 2018 (revamped 2022)
  • Ministry: Ministry of Labour & Employment
  • Purpose: Unemployment aid (25% of avg. salary for 3 months). For ESIC-insured workers.

Amazon Future Engineer Programme

  • Launched in: 2021
  • Ministry: Collaboration with Education Ministry
  • Purpose: Teach coding to 1 lakh+ govt school students annually.

PM PRANAM (Promotion of Alternate Nutrients for Agriculture Management)

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers
  • Purpose: Reduce chemical fertilizer use by incentivizing states for organic farming.

SVAMITVA (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas)

  • Launched in: 2020
  • Ministry: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
  • Purpose: Provide digital property cards to rural landowners; 1+ lakh villages mapped.

PM DIVINE (PM Development Initiative for North East)

  • Launched in: 2022
  • Ministry: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (DoNER)
  • Purpose: Accelerate infrastructure projects in Northeast (roads, telecom, tourism).

MISHTTI (Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes)

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change
  • Purpose: Plant mangroves along 540 km coastline to protect biodiversity and support livelihoods.

Naya Savera Scheme

  • Launched in: 2021
  • Ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
  • Purpose: Free coaching for minority students (JEE/NEET/UPSC). Covers 80,000+ students yearly.

SHREYAS (Scheme for Higher Education Youth in Apprenticeship and Skills)

  • Launched in: 2019
  • Ministry: Ministry of Education
  • Purpose: Integrate apprenticeships with degrees. Targets 10 lakh students by 2025.

GOBAR DHAN (Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan)

  • Launched in: 2018
  • Ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
  • Purpose: Convert cattle waste to biogas/fertilizer. Aims for 100% village coverage by 2025.

VAIBHAV Fellowship

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Science & Technology
  • Purpose: Attract 100+ NRI scientists annually for 3-year research collaborations.

UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik)

  • Launched in: 2016
  • Ministry: Ministry of Civil Aviation
  • Purpose: Regional air connectivity with fares capped at ₹2,500/hour; 470+ routes operational.

Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)

  • Launched in: 2016
  • Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture
  • Purpose: Provide affordable crop insurance to farmers (premium: 2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi).

MPLADS (Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme)

  • Launched in: 1993
  • Ministry: Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation
  • Purpose: MPs recommend developmental works (₹5 crore/MP/year) in their constituencies.

E-Bus Sewa Scheme

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
  • Purpose: Deploy 10,000 e-buses in 100 cities to reduce urban pollution.

SATHI (Seed Traceability, Authentication, and Holistic Inventory)

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
  • Purpose: Modernize agri-infrastructure (cold storage, seed hubs) for farmers.

PM KUSUM (Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahaabhiyan)

  • Launched in: 2019
  • Ministry: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy
  • Purpose: Promote solar energy in agriculture (30 lakh solar pumps, grid-connected farms).

NAMASTE (National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem)

  • Launched in: 2022
  • Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
  • Purpose: Eliminate manual scavenging by providing sanitation workers with PPE and training.

Amrit Dharohar Scheme

  • Launched in: 2023
  • Ministry: Ministry of Forest and Climate Change
  • Purpose: Develop spiritual tourism circuits (e.g., Ramayana, Buddhist trails).

AWARDS and HONOURS

CIVILIAN AWARDS

  • India's Civilian Awards recognize outstanding contributions in various fields, including arts, literature, science, public service, and social work. These awards are announced every year on Republic Day (26th January) and are conferred by the President of India at Rashtrapati Bhavan.

i. Bharat Ratna (Highest Civilian Award)

  • Eligibility: Any individual, irrespective of nationality.
  • Instituted in: 1954
  • Total recipients till date: 53 (as of 2024)
  • First recipient: C. Rajagopalachari, Dr. S. Radhakrishnan, and Dr. C.V. Raman (1954)
  • First female recipient: Indira Gandhi (1971)
  • First posthumous recipient: Lal Bahadur Shastri (1966)
  • First sportsperson recipient: Sachin Tendulkar (2014) (Also the Youngest recipient: at age 40)
  • Non-Indian recipients: Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan (1987); Nelson Mandela (1990)

2. Padma Awards

  • Instituted in: 1954
  • Fields covered: Arts, literature, education, science, industry, sports, medicine, social work, and public affairs.

  • First recipients:

#### iii. Padma Shri (Fourth-Highest Civilian Award)

GALLANTRY AWARDS

  • India's Gallantry Awards are presented to military personnel and civilians for acts of bravery and valor in the face of extreme danger. These awards are divided into wartime gallantry awards and peacetime gallantry awards.

1. Wartime Gallantry Awards

  • Param Vir Chakra (Highest Wartime Gallantry Award)
  • Mahavir Chakra (Second-Highest)
  • Vir Chakra (Third-Highest)

2. Peacetime Gallantry Awards

  • Ashoka Chakra (Highest Peacetime Gallantry Award)
  • Kirti Chakra (Second-Highest)
  • Shaurya Chakra (Third-Highest)

SPORTS AWARDS

  • India's Sports Awards recognize excellence in various sporting disciplines. These awards are presented annually by the President of India to honor outstanding achievements in sports and games.

1. Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award (Highest Sporting Honour)

  • Instituted: 1991-92
  • ₹25 Lakhs awarded by Mo Youth Affairs & Sports to each recipient.
  • First Recipient: Viswanathan Anand (Chess) - 1991-92.

  • Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM)
  • Agnipath Scheme

Tip for SSC 2025: Memorize the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (Feb 2024 announcement, ₹75,021 crore), PM Internship Scheme (1 lakh internships), and Vande Bharat Sleeper (2024) — these are the most-asked new launches of 2024.
Caveat: Always cross-check with PIB before exam day — scheme names and ministries are often re-branded or merged (e.g., MGNREGA → MGNREGS, MGNREGA site renamed).
